alerts.notLoaded: Wait for the config to finish loading before saving
alerts.invalidTopN: Top-N processes must be a positive whole number
alerts.invalidExpiresAt: Expiry must be an RFC 3339 timestamp (e.g. 2026-06-14T12:00:00Z)

clientDisplayName.label: Client display name
clientDisplayName.hint: Product name the end-user Client App shows in its window title, header, Start-Menu shortcut, and notification sender — brands the client per customer. Leave blank to inherit (the client falls back to its built-in default name).

targetVersion.label: Target version
targetVersion.hint: Rollout target version. Often left blank and set per-group (canary) instead.

targetVersionJitter.label: Rollout jitter
targetVersionJitter.hint: Random pre-download wait spreading a rollout across the fleet (humantime, e.g. 30m). 0s = no jitter.

heartbeatInterval.label: Heartbeat interval
heartbeatInterval.hint: How often each agent checks in (humantime, e.g. 30s).

hostPerfInterval.label: Host perf interval
hostPerfInterval.hint: Cadence of the whole-host CPU/memory snapshot loop (humantime, e.g. 60s).

processPerfEnabled.label: Per-process perf
processPerfEnabled.hint: Heavy per-process collection. Off by default and normally toggled per-pc for investigation.

processPerfTopN.label: Per-process top-N
processPerfTopN.hint: How many processes (by CPU%) each agent publishes per tick.

processPerfExpiresAt.label: Per-process perf expiry
processPerfExpiresAt.hint: RFC3339 timestamp after which per-process collection auto-stops, even while the toggle stays on. Blank = no expiry.

global.title: Global ConfigScope
global.description: Whole-fleet default, including the client's product name. Per-group / per-pc overrides win over this.
global.blankHint: Each field's greyed placeholder is the built-in default it inherits when left blank. Fill one in only to override it fleet-wide — blank keeps inheriting the (evolving) default rather than pinning today's value.

scope.description: Partial ConfigScope — only the fields you set are written. Blank fields fall through to the layer below.
scope.blankHint: Each field's greyed placeholder is what it resolves to if you leave it blank in this scope. Fill one in to override it here; blank deletes the key and inherits the layer below.
scope.blankHintGroupNote: (Placeholders show the built-in→global base; other groups' overrides are resolved per-PC and aren't reflected here.)

confirm.deleteDescription: Removes the override; the scope falls back through the layered config.

effective.title: Effective config for one PC
effective.description: Same view the agent's config_supervisor computes locally. Built-in → global → groups (last-wins) → pc.
